prompt: You often intend to start homework after school but end up chatting online for an hour. Which if-then plan is most likely to help you start?

options.text: Try harder to be disciplined in the evenings in general
Feel guilty whenever you chat, until the guilt makes you stop
If it is 4:30 pm and I have had a snack, then I will open my homework at the kitchen table for 25 minutes before checking messages
Do all homework on Sunday so weekday evenings do not matter

explanation: An implementation intention links a specific cue (time, place, just-finished snack) to a specific action, so the start is decided in advance instead of relying on in-the-moment willpower.
